final: WITH counts AS (SELECT PlaylistId, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY PlaylistId), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(track_count) AS avg_track_count FROM counts) SELECT counts.PlaylistId, counts.track_count, counts.track_count / average_count.avg_track_count AS ratio FROM counts CROSS JOIN average_count ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST, counts.PlaylistId LIMIT 10
